reason: The plugin is primarily an agent workflow orchestrator for DSH web users: it provides a side-chat floating input and slash commands that forward messages from the side-chat context into the main session as user messages, effectively bridging two conversation contexts for immediate action. Evidence points to UI injection, command handling, and host push/state routes, with no documented capabilities for file editing, data analysis pipelines, external integrations, or research tooling.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DSH Web 侧边聊天伴侣插件，可在侧边聊天窗口附近提供输入入口与斜杠命令，将内容一键作为主会话的下一条用户消息推送给主 Agent。
summaries.en: A DSH web companion plugin that lets users send text from the side-chat context as the main session’s next user message through a floating control or /notify /to-main commands.

capabilities: Forwards side-chat messages into the main session as user messages
Registers /notify and /to-main commands for message push
Injects a floating UI control in the web client and polls side-chat state
Exposes side-notify host routes for state/push operations

reasons.code: Message forwarding is implemented as immediate main-session follow-up via agent.followup, so content from side-chat can directly trigger main-agent turns.
Global slash commands (/notify, /to-main) can be executed from side-chat contexts to dispatch actions to the main session.
A host API path for side-notify state/push is defined with a trust-fence style route design, which is a non-trivial capability boundary.
